ranked.headline: Oncology models borrow from external cohorts, references and cell lines to generalise
ranked.summary: New preprints borrow from cell lines, older cohorts, methylation atlases or other cancers to strengthen tumour classification and survival prediction.

ranked.headline: Genetic effects on gene regulation mapped at cell-type and single-molecule resolution
ranked.summary: Single-cell eQTL mixed models, uncertainty-aware cell-type TWAS and single-molecule accessibility prediction push variant interpretation beyond bulk tracks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and calibration expose data-driven limits of molecular and protein predictors
ranked.summary: New benchmarks, conformal FDR control and negative post-training results show dataset properties and splits, not architecture, often govern reported performance.

ranked.headline: Foundation-model encoders transfer across modalities while stratified benchmarks expose generalization gaps
ranked.summary: Frozen pLM, folding and RNA encoders are being repurposed with light heads across interaction and variant tasks, while stratified benchmarks test whether gains hold.

ranked.headline: Perturbation response models face audits of architecture, plate design and baselines
ranked.summary: Preprints audit foundation-model perturbation predictors against baselines and plate confounds, alongside context-aware and memory-based alternatives.

ranked.headline: Spatial omics methods infer proteins, nuclei and cell identities across modalities and 3D
ranked.summary: Preprints and two journal papers extend cross-modal inference, from H&E to protein and RNA-guided morphology, alongside multi-omic integration and segmentation.

ranked.headline: DIA proteomics pipelines are benchmarked end to end on spike-in, plasma and tissue data
ranked.summary: Five papers evaluate DIA search, quantitation and downstream tools on controlled mixtures and real samples, yielding concrete workflow recommendations.

ranked.headline: Graph, hypergraph and language-model embeddings predict drug response, synergy and resistance
ranked.summary: New graph and language-model methods target drug response, synergy and miRNA-drug resistance prediction, alongside gene and sequence embedding tools.

ranked.headline: Foundation-model encoders and benchmarks rank enzymes, reactions and mutants for experimental follow-up
ranked.summary: New enzyme-focused models and a mutant-prioritization benchmark with a 150-mutant validation test how well learned scores rank candidates for experiments.

ranked.headline: Generative molecular models are assessed through staged filtration and experimental validation
ranked.summary: HEDGEHOG's stage-wise filtering of 22 generators on KRAS G12D shows attrition that standard metrics miss, alongside new conditioned generators and screening pipelines.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial methods add plausibility metrics and identifiability-aware dynamics models
ranked.summary: Nine preprints from early November 2026 pair spatial and single-cell dynamics inference with explicit checks on what the data can identify or validate.

ranked.headline: Curated databases for enzyme stability, kinetics and yeast regulation gain machine-readable access
ranked.summary: Three database updates expand curated, quantitative enzyme and regulatory data with programmatic access, supporting enzyme and metabolic engineering workflows.

ranked.headline: Curated knowledgebases and fusion-calling tools extend interpretation of cancer transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Database updates and new fusion and chimeric RNA methods give cancer RNA-seq more curated context and fewer false-positive transcript calls.

ranked.headline: Local magnitude representation makes C-alpha B-factor prediction cheaper than full factorization
ranked.summary: A new preprint cuts B-factor factorization cost from O(N^3) to O(Nk^3), while published ML work targets other properties, with fixed-solvent splits and fast spectroscopy surrogates.

ranked.headline: Models of unobserved zeros, lineage geometry and reversible mutations refine inference
ranked.summary: Three new methods target sampling zeros, massive CRISPR lineages and mutation reversions, where simpler models would distort networks, trees or transmission links.

ranked.headline: Proteomics tooling and repositories broaden to proteoforms, PTM localization, and glycoproteomics
ranked.summary: New DIA, localization, de novo and glycan-repository tools and updated MIRAGE guidelines extend proteomics coverage from peptides to proteoforms and glycoproteomics.

ranked.headline: Fine-tuned DNA language models target metagenomic taxonomy and resistance gene detection
ranked.summary: MicrobeRT adapts three DNA language models to metagenomic read tasks, while metagenome-mining and typing methods appear alongside it as adjacent work.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold 3 accuracy on novel RNAs is benchmarked as chemical probing and cryoEM resources tie models to data
ranked.summary: A new AF3 benchmark shows accuracy drops on novel RNAs, while probing-to-structure and cryoEM identification resources support experimental cross-checking.

ranked.headline: Expression variation modeled via isoform diversity, donor covariance, and cell-level disease scoring
ranked.summary: New preprints extend expression modeling to isoform diversity, within-donor covariance, spatial decontamination and Braak-stage disentanglement in disease cohorts.

ranked.headline: Stochastic and thermodynamic models link molecular variability to cellular growth and phenotypic state
ranked.summary: New models connect stochastic RNA repair, transcriptome folding energy and kinetic parameter uncertainty to cell state and metabolic predictions.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and organoid profiling resolves developmental and regulatory heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Single-cell transcriptomic, multiome and imaging workflows now quantify heterogeneity across kidney, neural, endothelial and glioblastoma systems.

ranked.headline: Fine-tuned ProGen generates antimicrobial peptides with interpretable probing analyses
ranked.summary: AMP prediction benchmarks show leakage and inconsistent evaluation, motivating standardized evaluation and curated noncanonical peptide data.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based detection and curation of prokaryotic genetic elements
ranked.summary: Replication origins and plasmid elements remain hard to annotate, and motif-agnostic and metagenome-scale tools now target them directly from sequence.

ranked.headline: Statistical and learned methods handle noisy density data in cryo-EM and cryo-ET
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply statistical and learned models to noisy cryo-EM and cryo-ET density, with new consistency and label-noise corrections.

ranked.headline: Transcript-level structure is resolved from long-read, short-read and single-cell RNA-seq
ranked.summary: Long-read and single-cell RNA-seq now support transcript annotation and splicing or polyadenylation analysis without relying on prior transcript models.

ranked.headline: Gut microbiome and host transcriptomic data consolidated into reusable public databases
ranked.summary: GutBiomeDB spans 168 464 samples and gutDBase integrates 175 datasets across 15 gut-related diseases, consolidating gut data for reuse.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models of single-cell perturbation response and gene regulatory causality
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair perturbation prediction with causal graph inference and multimodal regulatory models for single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Association Studies Gain Tools for Selection Bias and Replicability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address selection bias in GWAS, replicability from summary statistics, and survival-based resilience genes in irradiated macaques.

ranked.headline: Knowledge networks are scaffolding annotation and interpretation of omics data
ranked.summary: Public omics resources and metabolomics tools are increasingly built around explicit network or knowledge-graph structure to make annotations traceable.

ranked.headline: Panel-level references reconcile hidden diversity in wheat and cereal genomes
ranked.summary: Single-genome references miss variation; panel-level pan-references and consistent repeat annotations now capture it across assemblies.

ranked.headline: LLM-assisted extraction and curation of biological literature into domain resources
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM-assisted literature extraction with domain-specific curated resources in toxicology and avian influenza genomics.

ranked.headline: Compositional omics methods extend integration, covariate modeling and longitudinal analysis
ranked.summary: Compositional omics methods are moving beyond log-ratio transforms toward multi-view, longitudinal and covariate-aware feature inference.

ranked.headline: Efficient CPU and distributed tools for single-cell and protein sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Datasets now reach 10M cells and billion protein sequences, making runtime, memory, and reproducibility central constraints for analysis tools.

ranked.headline: Recovering coding sequences from assemblies and proteomes without reference annotation
ranked.summary: Annotation-independent searches of raw assemblies and proteomic data are now recovering divergent gene-family members and small encoded peptides.

ranked.headline: Reproducible software steps now standardize inputs upstream of statistical inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a proteomics tool release package reproducible data preparation steps ahead of downstream analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational methods probe protein conformations, pockets, and ligand-binding states
ranked.summary: Side-chain optimization, metadynamics, and protonation-state analyses now test predictions against structures, benchmarks, and energetics.

ranked.headline: Pooled assays and structure-based models probe yield, resistance and binder trade-offs
ranked.summary: Predictors for protein yield, drug resistance and binder behavior are now checked against measured or diagnostic outcomes rather than accepted as single outputs.

ranked.headline: Static refolding success does not establish dynamic stability of designed motif scaffolds
ranked.summary: MD-based benchmarking and AlphaFold3 ensemble tests now probe dynamics beyond single static predictions across motifs, loops and peptides.

ranked.headline: Quantum annealing and coalescent scaling reshape phylogenetic tree inference
ranked.summary: Recent work recasts species tree and rooted-tree partitioning tasks as tractable problems on quantum hardware and at million-taxon scale.

ranked.headline: Variant calling tied to methylation and chromatin state in plant and human genomes
ranked.summary: Recent tools recover genetic variants jointly with methylation and chromatin features, from single assays to pangenome-based satellite and transposon analyses.
